review_candidates.title: Personal Care Attendant (PCA)
review_candidates.description: myPlace Health is built around a simple but powerful belief: older adults deserve the support they need to live safely, independently, and with dignity in their own communities. As a PACE (Program of All Inclusive Care for the Elderly) organization backed by SCAN Group, myPlace Health brings together customized medical care, social activities, and daily support for participants and their families – all under one roof. Our centers are more than healthcare facilities. They are vibrant community hubs where participants are known by name, valued, and supported as whole people. Behind that experience is a dedicated, interdisciplinary team working together to coordinate care, remove barriers, and improve quality of life for some of the most medically and socially complex populations. For employees, myPlace Health offers the opportunity to do deeply meaningful work in a highly collaborative setting. Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas, and grow alongside a mission that prioritizes compassion, respect, and impact. The result is a culture where people feel connected—to their colleagues, their participants, and the communities they serve. At myPlace Health, work is more than a job. It’s a shared commitment to honoring what matters most. Position will be onsite located in Greater, Los Angeles This is a wonderful opportunity for a mission-driven team player to make a real difference in the lives of frail and vulnerable older adults in your community. In this role, you’ll bring warmth, kindness, and compassion to every interaction—whether you’re supporting participants with personal care, accompanying them to appointments, or sharing a smile during a group activity. You’ll work closely with families, caregivers, and our interdisciplinary care team (IDT) to ensure each participant feels safe, seen, and supported, while also staying attentive to any changes in their health or well-being. Responsibilities Offer Compassionate Daily Care – Help participants with everyday activities such as bathing, grooming, toileting, dressing, laundry, and meals—whether in the center, clinic, or occasionally in their homes. Be a Friendly Companion and Guide – Assist participants as they get in and out of our transportation vehicles and accompany them on rides or to offsite medical appointments as needed. Support Mealtimes with Heart – Make sure each participant receives the correct meal and offer a helping hand to those who need assistance with eating, always with patience and respect. Help Keep Everyone Active and Comfortable – Provide gentle physical assistance throughout the day using proper techniques to ensure safety and avoid injury for everyone. Pitch in with Food Service – Lend a hand with meal delivery and help create a welcoming and enjoyable dining experience. Take Simple Health Measures – Monitor vital signs and keep a watchful eye on participant well-being as directed by the care team. Keep Supplies Stocked and Ready – Ensure personal care supplies like incontinence items and grooming tools are available and organized. Follow Team Guidance with Care – Carry out care tasks and status checks based on directions from our interdisciplinary team. Connect with Warmth – Communicate clearly and kindly with participants, families, team members, and outside providers—building trust and teamwork every step of the way. Jump In Where Needed – You’re a flexible team player who’s ready to lend a hand wherever it’s needed to ensure participants receive the best care possible. We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members. Actively support the achievement of SCAN's vision and goals. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications And Experience A Heart for Service – You’re passionate about caring for older adults and feel called to support high-risk seniors and those with complex needs. Hands-On Experience – You have experience as a Personal Care Attendant (PCA) or Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), especially working with frail or elderly individuals. Safety First – You’re CPR and First Aid certified—or willing to complete certification within 60 days of starting. A Plus, Not a Must – CNA or Home Health Aide (HHA) certification is preferred but not required—we value your experience and heart just as much. Ready to Go – You’re flexible and willing to provide care in participants’ homes when needed. Bilingual Bonus – Speaking more than one language is a big plus in serving our diverse community. Reliable Transportation – You have a valid California driver’s license, dependable transportation, a clean driving record, and current auto insurance—ensuring you can safely reach those who need you most. Tuberculosis Screening Policy To ensure the health and safety of our members, if you are selected for this position, your job offer with SCAN will be contingent on providing proof of Tuberculosis screening upon hire or providing proof of a negative screening within the last year. If you have a disability/medical reason or sincerely held religious belief that prevents you to provide information required in this policy, SCAN will initiate and engage in the interactive process to evaluate what, if any, reasonable accommodations may be available. What's in it for you? Base salary range: $23.51 to $26 per hour Work mode: Onsite Greater, Los Angeles An annual employee bonus program Medical, Dental, Vision coverage Generous paid-time-off (PTO) 11 paid holidays per year, plus 1 additional floating holiday Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match. Robust employee recognition program Robust Wellness Program An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

review_candidates.title: Head of APFASL
review_candidates.company: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka
review_candidates.description: YOUR OPPORTUNITY TO LEAD, INSPIRE, AND EXCEL AWAITS AT CA SRI LANKA! HEAD OF APFASL – PUBLIC SECTOR WING OF CA SRI LANKA The Association of Public Finance Accountants of Sri Lanka (APFASL), the Public Sector Wing of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka (CA Sri Lanka), is committed to advancing public sector financial management through education, training, research, and professional development. We invite applications from suitably qualified, dynamic, and results-oriented professionals to take on this role. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversee the secretarial functions of APFASL, including the Annual Report and Annual General Meeting (AGM) process. Manage budgets for workshops, seminars, and public sector programmes. Ensure the cost-effective delivery of initiatives within allocated resources. Design and implement workshops, seminars, and study programmes to enhance public sector systems and human resource capabilities. Upgrade and oversee the curriculum, examinations, and certification processes for the Master’s in Public Financial Management Degree Programme (MPFM), SOE Directors' Leadership Development Programme, and the CPFA (UK) qualifications. Collaborate with public sector institutions to strengthen financial management practices. Liaise with Ministries, Departments, Provincial Councils, and Local Authorities to address training and development needs. Respond to stakeholder enquiries relating to public sector accounting standards and professional qualifications. Oversee the enrolment process for APFASL, CPFA, and CIPFA (UK) members. Function as Secretary to the Public Sector Accounting Standards Committee and APFASL. Manage the publication and dissemination of examination results for the CPFA and CIPFA (UK) qualifications. Manage the MPFM Degree Programme, SOE Directors' Leadership Development Programme, APFA/CPFA Annual Conference, Public Sector Annual Oration, Best Annual Reports and Accounts (BARA) Competition, and related events. Build and maintain relationships with key public sector stakeholders to foster collaboration. Guide and mentor team members involved in public sector programmes. QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS Be a member of CA Sri Lanka; membership of CIMA (UK), ACCA or CIPFA (UK) would be an added advantage. A postgraduate qualification, such as an MBA, MSc, MA or higher. A minimum of 10 years' post-qualification experience in a senior management role, with at least 5 years in the public sector. Strong knowledge of public financial management (PFM) practices, public sector accounting standards, and financial management systems. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to work in a computerised environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and perform effectively under pressure. Strong decision-making and organisational skills. Age should be below 50 years. APPLICATION If you are passionate and eager to contribute to CA Sri Lanka’s growth, please send your CV to careers@casrilanka.org

review_candidates.title: HSI (High-Speed Interface) PHY System Design Validation Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Develop and execute validation plans for HSI systems, such as PCIe, USB, DP, HDMI, UFS, CSI, and UCIe PHY. Design, implement, and maintain test benches and validation environments for system-level and interface-level testing. Perform signal integrity and protocol compliance testing using industry-standard tools and equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers). Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work closely with design and firmware teams to resolve issues. Document validation procedures, test results, and provide detailed reports to stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, firmware, and software engineers to ensure seamless integration and validation of HSI systems. Design and develop hardware PCB evaluation boards for HSI system validation. Conduct schematic capture, component selection, and PCB system design for evaluation boards. Support board bring-up, debugging, and troubleshooting of hardware evaluation platforms. Stay updated with the latest industry standards and best practices for HSI and PCB system design. Main Requirements and Qualifications Qualification: Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Communication, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Solid understanding of HSI protocols (e.g., PCIe, USB, DP, HDMI, UFS, CSI, and UCIe PHYs). Experience with system-level validation, signal integrity analysis, and protocol compliance testing. Proficiency in using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers. Hands-on experience in hardware PCB design, including schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review. Familiarity with PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, Mentor Graphics). Knowledge of PCB system design principles, including signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC considerations, and high-speed layout techniques. Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl) for test automation is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with FPGA or IC validation. Knowledge of board-level design and debugging. Experience in developing automated test scripts and frameworks.

review_candidates.title: HR Systems Integration Engineer
review_candidates.description: Say hello to Hagerty Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! As the HR Systems Integration Engineer, your primary focus is to design, develop, and manage seamless integrations between HR systems, ensuring accurate and efficient data flow across platforms. Additionally, the role provides strategic support and technical expertise to optimize HR system performance and align it with organizational goals. This position bridges the gap between technical integration and system analysis, enabling the HR team to leverage technology for improved decision-making and operational efficiency. What You’ll Do Collaborate with stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and various internal and external systems using Workday Integration Cloud (EIBs, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, etc.). Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support user acceptance testing for integrations. Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues in a timely manner. Document integration processes, configurations, and changes. Provide technical support and guidance to end-users regarding Workday integrations. Mentor and guide the broader Workday team to ensure the quality of solutions provided. Coordinate changes with Finance and HR System Analysts. Stay updated on Workday releases and new features related to integrations. Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives as a Workday integration subject matter expert. Collaborate closely with stakeholders, including business users and integration partners, to validate integration requirements and ensure alignment with business processes. Implement a comprehensive QA process to ensure the reliability and accuracy of Workday HR integrations. Facilitate cross-training sessions with the FIN integrations team to share knowledge, best practices, and insights between HR and FIN integration teams, fostering collaboration and alignment across functional areas. Analyze and evaluate HR system functionalities, identifying areas for improvement and optimizing system performance. Provide high-level technical support and guidance to HR team members and other stakeholders on system-related issues. Lead system testing efforts for updates, enhancements, and new implementations, ensuring systems meet business needs. Participate in HRIS projects, providing both technical and strategic insights to align systems with organizational goals. Develop and deliver training materials and sessions to end-users, enhancing their understanding and utilization of HR systems. This might describe you Basic understanding of Workday modules: HCM, Recruiting, Benefits, Payroll, Analytics, Time Tracking, and Absence. Experience with Workday Tenant Management. Ability to design and develop technical solutions that meet business, operational, risk, and technology requirements. Understanding of integration design, development, implementation, and maintenance. Proficiency in writing documents and executing requirements, design development, and testing. Basic understanding of XML fundamentals and database query languages. Ability to prioritize tasks effectively in response to changing business needs. Strong interpersonal skills and customer service orientation. Experience working with diverse stakeholders and all levels of management. Other Things To Note This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week. Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable. If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email recruiting@hagerty.com for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart. At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference. We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.
